segments.comment: mention_map, a level 17 dark room, Warning from #wizintrinsic, eight sleeping lichens on the adjacent squares and a ya thrown north into the dark. ^G then creates a fire vortex two squares away. makemon.c makemon() gives it a light source (1349) and draws it with newsym() (1473) while its square is dark, so display.c show_glyph() (2011-2068) reports the warning glyph through pline_xy(). pline.c vpline() (266-272) recalculates vision before printing that line: the ya the vortex lights is reported first, '(2north): a +0 ya.--More--', then '(2north,1east): unknown creature causing you anxiety.--More--', and makemon()'s canseemon() test (1479) then prints 'A fire vortex appears close by.'
